'Oedipus El Rey' is one remarkable night at the theater: Gripping, inventive, comic on the fringes, yet inexorable in its slow lowering of the boom on a tyrant who believes himself invincible.

What I enjoyed about Oedipus El Rey is its liveliness and the imaginative retelling while still managing to stay true to its timeless mythological roots.
